messages:
liam: deploy-bot posted: promoting chart checkout v3.2.1 -> prod; canary 15% started

deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: latency_p50(/checkout) increased 2.1x and errors_502 > threshold for 90s. chart=checkout v3.2.1, detected values override: checkout.circuitBreaker.enabled=true, checkout.redis.maxPool=4. Suggested actions: revert override, patch values to maxPool=16, or rollback to v3.2.0.

sre_oncall: seeing connection resets from redis clients during warmup, correlated with maxPool=4. pods hitting connection limit and under-provisioned.

anya: who approved that values override? I thought circuit breaker was gated in staging only.

liam: PR #512 in infra/helm-overrides added this during a late tweak. cc @release-manager-kyle

release-manager-kyle: change window still open for another 40m. two options: quick hotfix to bump redis.maxPool to 16 or rollback chart to v3.2.0. Hotfix procedure below — requires one approval: `helm upgrade checkout ./charts/checkout --namespace prod --reuse-values --set checkout.redis.maxPool=16 --timeout 3m --wait`

nate: hotfix less disruptive, will reduce blast radius and keep chart version for release notes consistency. if hotfix fails, we rollback.

sre_oncall: recommend also disabling circuitBreaker for now (`checkout.circuitBreaker.enabled=false`) until we validate behavior.

deploy-bot: To perform values hotfix in prod, approval from release-manager-kyle required.

release-manager-kyle: approve. nate take lead. docs prepare a short advisory for support.

nate: executing hotfix: `helm upgrade checkout ./charts/checkout --namespace prod --reuse-values --set checkout.redis.maxPool=16 --set checkout.circuitBreaker.enabled=false --timeout 3m --wait`

nate: rollout 25% -> 60% -> 100%

sre_oncall: metrics show p50 latency back to baseline and 502s dropped to normal. good signal.

docs: drafting note: "Hotfixed redis maxPool and disabled checkout circuit breaker after elevated 502/latency during canary. No rollback performed. Monitoring extended for 1h." Will push to release-notes doc.

deploy-bot: RESUME: canary resumed promotion to v3.2.1 but promotion will remain manual until override PR is reverted. Action items: [1] Revert infra override PR #512 (https://git.redwood/infra/helm-overrides/pull/512), [2] Merge follow-up bump if needed, [3] Extend change window to +30m.

liam: created follow-up issue and linked PR revert: https://git.redwood/infra/helm-overrides/pull/516

anya: adding postmortem note to thread if alerts recur. For now marking as held-watched.

liam: closing thread — watching alerts for 60m. no chart rollback performed.
